ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2023a), powered by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, can achieve significant zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning (ICL)  performance on unseen tasks, even without any parameter updates. In this section, we investigate the performance of ChatGPT on ABSA tasks and its ability for finegrained understanding of segmental context.
